archive_links: Bazel 9.3 tar/tar.gz/zip symlinks (normalized, strip-prefixed targets created after all entries; absolute targets re-rooted and replanted relative like Bazel) and real tar hard links to deprefixed in-root paths (missing targets fail with Bazel's text); later regular entries win in place; tar links replace existing paths, zip links over an existing path fail like Bazel; zip escape check with Bazel's message and archive basename, tar escaping links preserved; link-below-link (nondeterministic in Bazel), write-through and outside hard links rejected explicitly; manifests record literal targets; MODULE/overlay/patch writes replace links and break hard links; source artifacts follow in-repository links (dangling = missing input, cycles = Bazel's circular-symlink report, outside root = error) and, since N26, .bzl loads too; links leaving a repository are followed only into repositories materialized in the same invocation (never the repository store; other host paths only from repository-rule-generated repositories); glob() follows links under the same policy (N28d) while package-directory links stay unsupported; see docs/ARCHIVE_SYMLINKS.md

label_syntax: N38: Bazel 9.3 label grammar, validation and exact error texts everywhere labels are parsed (attributes, load(), Label(), select keys, visibility, package_group, repository and tag attributes, PackageSpecificationInfo.contains, CLI); TargetPattern.Parser (//..., p/..., :all, :*, :all-targets, ...:* forms, relative patterns against the working directory, path-as-target, the wildcard-conflict warning, no targets found beneath); negative build patterns merged in order; query residue joined into one expression for the query language (docs/QUERY.md), whose target-literal words parse with TargetPattern.Parser; //... skips directories whose names are invalid package names silently, explicit labels do not cross them, globs stop at any directory with a BUILD file (PathPackageLocator); $(location)/$(locations) shell-escaped; repository-execution .bzl sources decoded as Latin-1 (raw non-ASCII literals accepted; non-ASCII load() labels explicit); paired receipt tests/fixtures/label_syntax/reference_receipt.json (82 rows, 0 mismatches); runfiles manifest escaping not modelled (no runfiles trees); non-UTF-8 glob entries explicit; see docs/LABEL_SYNTAX.md
label_constructor: Label(input, /) accepts a string or an existing genuine Label; existing Values retain identity without parsing, remapping or allocation; strings retain lexical resolution; wrong types and keyword/arity errors use typed binding; unknown apparent repositories yield Bazel's invalid Label (@@[unknown repo 'R' requested from @@C<did-you-mean>]) whose repo_name/workspace_name/workspace_root getters fail with Bazel's text (N45, docs/EXTENSION_REPO_MAPPING.md); see docs/LABEL_PASSTHROUGH.md

execution: bounded parallel local action DAG via build --jobs=N; spawns run Bazel 9.3's argv (N41): genrules `/bin/bash -c 'source external/bazel_tools/tools/genrule/genrule-setup.sh; CMD'` with the embedded genrule-setup.sh input (a content-addressed blob), run_shell `/bin/bash -c CMD` plus an empty $0 only with arguments, run with the executable's execution path as argv[0]; every process with exactly its Bazel 9.3 action environment (fixed values, inherited client values resolved once per build, a fresh absolute TMPDIR that replaces any action TMPDIR; no native PATH/LANG/LC_ALL defaults; docs/ACTION_ENV.md), non-strict custom run_shell, direct program run; ETXTBSY spawn-only retry capped at 8 attempts with 127 ms total requested backoff, never retries process exits; isolated working directories, NOT a security sandbox; read-only hardlinked inputs, in-place input modification fails the action (docs/HARDLINK_STAGING.md)
